subject: Baseline behavior when a semantic result is retried through generic add
source_of_truth: Temporary repository-local SQLite index and NDJSON shard written by the merged Auditctl add command.
initial_state: Isolated temporary repository with an empty Auditctl ledger.
No existing event has the semantic observation interpretation key.

operations.name: submit identical semantic event twice through generic add

parameters.payload: same summary, refs, metadata, key, and timestamp

consistency.object: generic add is not idempotent by semantic key and returns a newly minted event identity for each invocation

assumptions.isolation: Each generic add allocates a new Auditctl event ID; no semantic-key check exists in the merged base implementation.
assumptions.clock: A fixed timestamp is supplied so only generated event identity differs.
assumptions.fairness: Not applicable to the sequential baseline.

invariants: The reproduction touches only the temporary fixture, never shared or production artifacts.
The observed duplicate comes from repeated generic add calls; no exactly-once guarantee is attributed to that command.
faults: Repeat an identical event payload with the same semantic interpretation key.
oracles: Compare the returned event IDs from both invocations.
Query the temporary ledger and count semantic.observation rows.
